passages.provision_quote: the victim shall notify the prosecution of their request to be heard within 15 days of being notified that resentencing is being sought and the court shall provide an opportunity for the victim to be heard
passages.note: The bill sets notice and hearing rights for crime victims at resentencing and parole hearings; it does not change what the system does to the person who broke the law.

rows.reasoning: The only source is AB 88 (2023-2024), which Sanchez authored; its operative sections amend Penal Code 1172.1 and 3043 so that a victim who "wishes to be heard" at a resentencing gets "an opportunity for the victim to be heard" and so that "The department and the board may require no more than 15 days\u2019 notice" from victims attending a parole hearing. Those clauses govern who may speak at a hearing, not whether the system answers lawbreaking with "support and treatment, not punishment" or with "the toughest penalties the law allows", so the passage is adjacent to the dimension these rungs separate. No passage survives V1\u2013V5, so the row is blank for want of evidence.
